findings.message: The fixed workspace path breaks local checkouts named anything other than ProxmoxMCP-Plus. The automatic source mount follows the checkout directory name; workspaceFolder does not relocate it ([mount documentation](https://code.visualstudio.com/remote/advancedcontainers/change-default-source-mount)). For a checkout named proxmox-dev, VS Code opens a nonexistent directory and postCreateCommand cannot install the project. Use the default workspace location or configure a matching workspaceMount, and make the interpreter path workspace-relative.

This command does not install the development dependencies. pyproject.toml selects hatchling and defines no dev optional dependency; the extras_require declaration in setup.py is therefore ignored. The container finishes setup without pytest, pytest-asyncio, mypy, or the other development packages, so contributors cannot run the test suite in the advertised ready-to-code environment. Install requirements-dev.in explicitly alongside the editable project, or define the dev extra in pyproject.toml.
